map.输入用药方案后生成日程，可打印/导出，辅助长期提醒（本地生成，不上传）。: Enter the medication plan to generate a schedule, printable and exportable, assisting long-term reminders (generated locally, not uploaded).
map.📖 查看「用药提醒表 使用指南」: View the Medication Reminder Table User Guide
map.服药间隔按频次折算：每日 1 次为 24 小时、每日 2 次为 12 小时、每日: The dosing interval is converted from the frequency: once a day is 24 hours, twice a day is 12 hours, three times a day is 8 hours, four times a day is 6 hours; dosing time point = first dose time + interval x n (n starting from 0); total times per day = 24 / interval; multiple medicines are merged and sorted on the timeline to generate an all-day medication reminder table.
map.多病共病老人常需多种药物，用计划表梳理药名、剂量、频次与首次服药时间。: Older adults with multiple conditions often need many medicines; use a plan sheet to organise the name, dose, frequency and first dose time.
map.按 24 小时制排布给药点，避免漏服/重复并提示相互作用。: Dose points are laid out on a 24-hour clock, avoiding missed or duplicated doses and flagging interactions.
map.复杂方案建议与医生/药师核对，尤其抗凝、降糖、降压类。: Complex plans should be checked with a doctor or pharmacist, especially anticoagulants, hypoglycaemic drugs and antihypertensives.
map.逐项添加『药名-剂量-间隔(小时)-首次时间』，如『降压药 1片 间隔24 首次: Add 'name - dose - interval (hours) - first time' item by item, e.g. 'antihypertensive 1 tablet, interval 24, first 08:00'; the tool computes the following dose times from the interval and generates a daily table.
map.将给药点叠加到一天时间轴，可发现是否多个药撞在同一时刻需分开、或某时段空腹/餐后: Overlay the dose points on a one-day timeline to discover whether several medicines clash at the same moment and need separating, or whether a fasting/after-meal requirement conflicts in a given period, so it can be confirmed with the pharmacist in advance.
map.多药同服要注意什么？: What to watch for when taking several medicines together?
map.重点查相互作用与给药时机（空腹/餐后）、重复成分（如多种感冒药含同种成分）、以及: Focus on interactions and dosing timing (fasting / after meals), duplicated ingredients (for example several cold remedies containing the same ingredient), and the effect of liver and kidney function on the dose. Any change to the plan must go through a doctor or pharmacist.
map.漏服了怎么办？: What if a dose is missed?
map.切勿自行加倍补服。多数情况按『想起即补、若近下次给药则跳过』原则，具体遵药品说明: Never double up on your own. In most cases follow the principle of 'take it as soon as you remember, and skip it if it is close to the next dose'; follow the package insert or consult the pharmacist to avoid overdosing.
